status: DRAFT (not registered; sha256 not pinned in live_tests3.py; census scales and k not filled)
design: docs/research_lab/LIVE_TESTS_3.md (sections 1-9 as amended by section 13, the response to challenger R1)
k_tests_rule: list of the primaries that survived their census gates (section 13.6), fixed before the pin; Holm m = len(k_tests); null = not filled (a pinned spec with null k_tests is refused)

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: crypto = fee_type starts with 'crypto' or the first series slug matches slug_regex (section 13, finding 2)

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug' (one family: one spot driver)

move.class_rule: never_traded (ltp absent at k-1 and k) > traded (L or V+) > ambiguous (V-, ltp present at k-1 and absent at k, or volume24hr unknown) > quote_only (not L, V0); geometry for every unit: parallel (sign db = sign da = sign x, both >= 0.005, |db - da| <= 0.005), one_sided (min(|db|,|da|) <= 0.0005), spread_change (opposite signs, both > 0.0005), same_side_unequal (rest)

e019.exclude_rule: fixed from census C4 before the pin: if one series family holds > 50% of the high-breadth untraded non-sports units, exclude_crypto = true (and exclude_family = that family if it is not a crypto family); else false (section 13, finding 2)

surge.rule: S: vol_k >= 3 vol_{k-1} and vol_k - vol_{k-1} >= 500; A: S and max(|x_k|, |x_{k-1}|) < 0.01; SM: S and max(|x_k|, |x_{k-1}|) >= 0.01; S with x_{k-1} unknown -> lag_unknown (excluded, counted); baseline: not S (section 13, finding 8)

flow.walk_rule: a signed row is walked if the sidecar tick at the sample's capture is known and |p - tick * round(p / tick)| >= 1e-4 (section 13, finding 4); tick unknown -> the row is left out of W (numerator and denominator)
flow.categories: all (sports reported split; category is a parameter, section 13 finding 12)

e018.underpowered_ref_rule: a slope has no cent floor; the underpowered label uses the top of the planning MDE range per SD (0.0029, section 3) as the reference (section 13, item U)

size_check.rule: rejection rate of each gate under each simulated null must not exceed 0.05 + 1.645 * sqrt(0.05 * 0.95 / worlds) (not significantly above 5%); run on the code to be pinned, result recorded in section 13 and the spec before the pin

census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / census days (estimate); distinct events: E_2d + (E_2d - E_day1) x 19 (new-event rate of day 2 carried forward; estimate)
